before: ARC-0036 is applied and the Story is compiled: `log.txt` ends with `0 error(s)`.
A new Veilwalker at level 12 (or levelled 1 → 12 as you go), a fight with three or more enemies. Console edition.

sessions.name: Any level — full run
sessions.setup: The Veilwalker at level 12 in a fight with three or more enemies.

tests.steps: Compile in the Story Editor; open `Mods/AspectClass_…/Story/log.txt`
tests.title: The Story compiles clean

tests.expected: Each card sits where it was, with the new id (`…_SeedOfDoubt`, `…_Eidolon`, `…_Veilstep`, `…_BindingFalsehood`, `…_TwiceTold_…`, `…_Arcana_Double_…`); the Rulebook lists 8 rules: FacelessCopy, DoubleOfTheVeil, DoubleOfTheVeil_3, _4, _5_NoUnveil, _5, _6_NoUnveil, _6 — no `New_Stat`
tests.fails: An entry moved, an old id is left, or a rule is missing
tests.rule: DV37 (renamed in place); OR-12 (both Rulebook copies)
tests.steps: Open the Toolkit; look at the Veilwalker spells in the Stats Editor and at Shapeshift / Rulebook
tests.title: The Toolkit shows the new names in their old places

tests.expected: Every card is in her spellbook and casts; every linked word opens its tooltip (Seed, Doubt, Splinter, Binding Falsehood, Twice-Told…)
tests.fails: A card is missing, does not cast, or a link shows an empty tooltip
tests.rule: DV37 (ids in lists, progressions and LSTags)
tests.steps: Cast each Veilwalker card once; hover each underlined word in their tooltips
tests.title: Every card casts and every tooltip link opens

tests.expected: Level 5+: Reflected Seed and Reflected Falsehood beside Splinter, Dash, Disengage and Dismiss; level 9+: Unveil too
tests.rule: DESIGN §4.2, Two Truths, Unveil (the restored rules)
tests.steps: Summon a Double with Eidolon; open its hotbar at level 5, then at level 9 or later
tests.title: The Doubles cast her spells from level 5 and swap from level 9

tests.expected: That Double splinters at once, the enemies take the burst and 1 Doubt each, and the Double is gone
tests.fails: Nothing happens, or the Double stays after its Splinter
tests.steps: With a Double near two enemies, cast Splinter on Command
tests.title: Splinter on Command and the Splinter cleanup

tests.expected: The struck Double bursts by itself (4 m, Doubt); The Veil Lifts splinters every Double and bursts every Seed
tests.fails: A struck Double dies without a burst, or The Veil Lifts leaves Doubles standing
tests.rule: Aspect card The Veil Lifts; Tier III, the lie explodes
tests.steps: Reach Tier III; let an enemy strike a Double; later use The Veil Lifts with Doubles and Seeds on the field
tests.title: The Veil Lifts and the Tier III burst

tests.expected: The Seed bursts with its Doubt; Twice-Told offers the last card; the Awakening progress counts Doubt down and Tier I arrives
tests.fails: The Seed never bursts, Twice-Told is empty, or the Awakening never counts
tests.rule: Seed of Doubt (`SEED`), Twice-Told, Awakening (*HighPriestess* key)
tests.steps: Cast Seed of Doubt, then a damaging card on the same enemy; use Twice-Told; fight until Tier I
tests.title: The Seed, Twice-Told and the Awakening

title: The Veilwalker — ids renamed, the Double's rules restored (any level)
